headline: Pakistan and the UK expressed concern on Wednesday over the continuing threat from terrorist groups, including the TTP, operating in and from Afghanistan, during their annual counter-terrorism dialogue in Islamabad, the Foreign Office said, Dawn reports.

card.desc: Islamabad mein saalana counter-terrorism dialogue hua.

caption:
Pakistan aur UK ki dehshatgardi ke khatre par fikr!
